descriptions.39914: The largest and tallest climbing centre in the Nordic countries. It has eight different sectors and seven auto-belay devices. Wall heights range from around 5 m for bouldering walls to 30 m for climbing walls.
descriptions.39928: The Ilkantie campus of Stadin Vocational College has a 451 m² sports hall with evening supervision. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users, but the school lends gymnastics mats and large and small floorball goals, as well as futsal and handball goals. The baskets and goals allow basketball, floorball, futsal and handball. There are no floorball boards.
descriptions.39942: The Savonkatu campus of Stadin Vocational College has a 342 m² sports hall with evening supervision. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users. The baskets and court markings allow basketball. A mirrored wall makes activities such as dance possible.
descriptions.39974: Dance studio and gymnastics space. Bulevardin Teatteriyhdistys ry is responsible for activities in the training rooms on the east side.
descriptions.39993: A school sports hall with a low ceiling and an asymmetrical shape. It is particularly suitable for dance. Two walls have mirrors, and one wall has wall bars. Two ceiling pillars stand in the middle of the space.
descriptions.39995: Zacharias Topeliusskolan has a 161 m² sports hall with evening supervision. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users. A mirrored wall makes activities such as dance possible.
descriptions.40005: Pohjois-Haaga Elementary School has a 368 m² sports hall available for self-supervised use. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users. The baskets and court markings allow basketball.
descriptions.40044: The hall has three side-by-side courts for beach volleyball. The courts can also be used for beach soccer. The sand is white quartz sand specially produced in Germany. The space is eight metres high.
descriptions.40095: Aerobics and dance studio, gymnastics space. Mirrors.
descriptions.40168: The sauna and changing room areas have a combined floor area of 66 m².
descriptions.40264: Aerobics and dance studio, floorball court, gymnastics space and gym.
descriptions.40268:
The hall is available for evening and leisure-time use with self-supervised access.

A small hall for dance and gymnastics.
descriptions.40409:
The hall is available for evening and leisure-time use with self-supervised access.

The hall has a stage and gymnastics space.
descriptions.40416: Meilahti Elementary School has a 244 m² sports hall available for self-supervised use. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users. The baskets and large and small floorball goals allow basketball and floorball. There are no floorball boards. A mirrored wall makes activities such as dance possible.
descriptions.40423: All spaces at Ruskeasuo School, including public areas such as lobbies and catering areas, as well as special facilities such as the swimming pool and accommodation rooms, are accessible. The facilities are intended for private use but can also be rented. The sports hall has wall bars.
descriptions.40440: Paloheinä Elementary School has a 408 m² sports hall available for self-supervised use. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users. The baskets and court markings allow basketball.
descriptions.40448: Torpparinmäki Comprehensive School has a 235 m² sports hall available for self-supervised use. The school's equipment storage is available to evening users. Nets, baskets, and large and small floorball goals allow badminton, basketball and floorball. There are no floorball boards.
descriptions.40512: Gymnastics space. The room can also be used for activities such as yoga.
descriptions.40518: Ressu Comprehensive School has a smaller 204 m² assembly hall and a larger 218 m² sports hall. The halls are booked separately and have evening supervision. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users. The baskets allow basketball.
descriptions.40529: Åshöjdens grundskola has a 197 m² sports hall and a 207 m² assembly hall. The halls are booked separately and available for self-supervised use. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users. The baskets in the sports hall allow basketball.
descriptions.40575: The sports hall has two basketball hoops, a volleyball net, three badminton nets, wall bars, ropes, rings, a sound system and a stage. Step-free access to the hall and an accessible toilet.
descriptions.40582:
The school is undergoing a major renovation, including technical building repairs and yard renewal, but the lower hall has been completed and bookings began in autumn 2025.

The sports hall is available for evening and leisure-time use with evening supervision.
descriptions.40591:
The school was under renovation from January 2023 to June 2025.

The sports hall is available for evening and leisure-time use with evening supervision.
There is no accessible route into the hall.
descriptions.40736:
A shot put circle in Laajasuo Sports Park, offering good opportunities to practise the sport. The park is about a 10-minute walk from Pohjois-Haaga railway station.

The shot put circle is freely available. Equipment is not available to borrow on site. The facility can be used during the sports park's opening hours, which you can check via the 'Laajasuo Sports Park' link.

Getting there: Laajasuo Sports Park has no parking area, but you can get there by public transport or city bike, for example.
descriptions.40758: Haaga Comprehensive School on Isonnevantie has a 248 m² sports hall and a 300 m² assembly hall. The halls are booked separately and available for self-supervised use. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users. The baskets and court markings in both halls allow basketball.
descriptions.40809: The hall has mirrors and is particularly suitable for dance groups. It also has music equipment.
descriptions.40848:
A grass mini-pitch in Siltamäki Sports Park, suitable for playing and practising football. The sports park is in Siltamäki, along the Tuusula Highway.

The park has three small grass fields. They are not freely available and can only be used during booked time slots. The fields can be used during the sports park's opening hours, which you can check via the 'Siltamäki Sports Park' link.

Getting there: The sports park has a parking area and can also be reached by public transport, for example.
descriptions.40849: Koskela Elementary School has a 101 m² sports hall with evening supervision. The school's equipment storage is available to evening users. The basketball hoops and large floorball goals allow basketball and floorball. There are no floorball boards.
descriptions.40874: Aerobics studio, floorball court and gymnastics space. 200 m² spectator stand.
descriptions.40890: Outdoor sand riding arena. Lit by floodlights on poles. The sports park has a café, meeting rooms and a parking area. Suitable for people with reduced mobility.
descriptions.40902: Katajanokka Elementary School has a 215 m² sports hall available for self-supervised use. The school's equipment storage is available to evening users. Two large floorball goals allow floorball; there are no floorball boards. The hall has one adjustable basketball hoop for practising basketball.
descriptions.40930: A small sports hall also used extensively for cultural activities. Suitable for adapted games and small group exercise sessions.
descriptions.40949: The Nilsiänkatu 3 campus of Stadin Vocational College has a 408 m² sports hall with evening supervision. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users, but the school lends large and small floorball goals. The baskets and goals allow basketball and floorball. There are no floorball boards.
descriptions.40953:
Finland's first disc golf course, a 16-basket woodland course with hilly terrain and significant elevation changes.

The baskets are privately owned, but the course is open to everyone. The sports hall café at Meilahti Sports Park is next to the first tee.
descriptions.41020: The room has mirrors and costs €30 per hour to rent. The ballet studio can also be reconfigured for other uses during events. If needed, a separate entrance to the room can be opened from the Tower car park.
descriptions.41041: Kruununhaka Lower Secondary School has a 201 m² sports hall available for self-supervised use. There is no storage room or equipment available to borrow. Take extra care because there is a piano in the hall. A mirrored wall makes activities such as dance possible.
descriptions.41044: The room is also used as a restaurant space.
descriptions.41051: For more information about the hall's services, opening hours and contact details, visit the Urheiluhallit website.
descriptions.41070: Maunula Elementary School has a 225 m² sports hall and a 189 m² assembly hall. The halls are booked separately and available for self-supervised use. The school's equipment storage is available to evening users. In the larger hall, nets, baskets, and large and small floorball goals allow volleyball, badminton, basketball and floorball. There are no floorball boards. A mirrored wall in the larger hall makes activities such as dance possible.
descriptions.41214:
The sports hall is available for evening and leisure-time use with evening supervision.

The hall has mirrors and an AV system. It is suitable for small-group exercise and activities such as table tennis.
descriptions.41230: The school has both an assembly hall and a sports hall. The sports hall is currently unavailable for evening use because it is used for teaching. The ceiling is too low for volleyball and possibly for badminton. Equipment includes wall bars, ropes, rings and two basketball hoops.
descriptions.41246: There is step-free access to the changing rooms and sports hall.
descriptions.41343: The Kullervonkatu campus of Stadin Vocational College has a 388 m² sports hall available for self-supervised use. The school's equipment storage is available to evening users. Nets, baskets and goals allow badminton, volleyball, basketball, floorball, futsal and handball. There are no floorball boards. Both large and small floorball goals are available.
descriptions.41372: Kannelmäki Comprehensive School on Kannelmäentie has a 224 m² sports hall available for self-supervised use. The school's goals are available to evening users. Nets, baskets, and large and small floorball goals allow volleyball, badminton, basketball and floorball. There are no floorball boards.
descriptions.41381: A school-use sports hall located at one end of the larger sports hall.
descriptions.41399: Töölö Elementary School has a 188 m² sports hall available for self-supervised use. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users. The baskets and court markings allow basketball.
descriptions.41411: Spectator seating for over 2,000 people. Ball sports, gym, group exercise, a fitness testing station, meeting rooms and a bookable sauna. The court can be divided into three smaller courts with curtain dividers. The ball sports hall also has two separate badminton courts.
descriptions.41435: Aerobics studio and floorball court. Generally open to students.
descriptions.41444: Five of the tennis courts are covered by air domes in winter. The indoor sports hall has a 137 m² spectator stand, equipment rental, a tennis shop and a café. The courts have been under renovation since 2018.
descriptions.41480: Pasila Comprehensive School on Savonkatu has a 155 m² sports hall with evening supervision. The school's equipment storage is available to evening users if borrowing is agreed in advance. Nets, baskets and large and small floorball goals allow badminton, volleyball, basketball and floorball. There are no floorball boards.
descriptions.41506: Minerva School has a 153 m² sports hall available for self-supervised use. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users. The baskets and court markings allow basketball.
descriptions.41611: A small hall reserved for school use and suitable for dance-based exercise. It has wall bars, mirrors and a sound system. It is not suitable for ball sports because of the mirrors. There are no changing rooms next to the hall.
descriptions.41628: An artificial turf field rented to local football clubs.
descriptions.41629: The fitness and gymnastics room is well equipped for gym training. It is also excellent for music-based exercise, dance (with a mirrored wall) and gymnastics.
descriptions.41631: For more information about the hall's services, opening hours and contact details, visit the Urheiluhallit website.
descriptions.41756: Arabianranta Comprehensive School has a 525 m² sports hall available for self-supervised use. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users. The baskets and court markings allow basketball. A mirrored wall makes activities such as dance possible.
descriptions.41759: Kaisaniemi Elementary School has a 149 m² sports hall available for self-supervised use. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users. The baskets and mirrored wall allow basketball and dance.
descriptions.41772: Best suited to music-based exercise, gymnastics and performances. Stage and seating for 350 people.
descriptions.41792:
The Olympic riding arena in Ruskeasuo Sports Park offers excellent opportunities for horse riding. The park is about a 20-minute walk from Pasila station, on the edge of Central Park.

There are no public sessions or opportunities for independent practice. The arena is reserved for riding stables during booked time slots only.

Getting there: The sports park has a parking area and can also be reached by public transport or city bike, for example.
descriptions.41817:
A grass mini-pitch in Siltamäki Sports Park, suitable for playing and practising football. The sports park is in Siltamäki, along the Tuusula Highway.

The park has three small grass fields. They are not freely available and can only be used during booked time slots. The fields can be used during the sports park's opening hours, which you can check via the 'Siltamäki Sports Park' link.

Getting there: The sports park has a parking area and can also be reached by public transport, for example.
descriptions.41848:
Kottby grundskola, formerly known as Kottby lågstadieskola, was expanded into a comprehensive school. The new building, including its sports facilities, replaced the old premises. Bookings for the sports hall began in January 2026.
The sports hall is available for evening and leisure-time use with evening supervision.
descriptions.41860: The sports hall at Nuotta Youth Centre is best suited to dance. It can also be used for floorball, badminton and basketball.
descriptions.41868: The large sports hall can be used for ball sports such as basketball, volleyball, handball, football and badminton (five courts), as well as floorball. Spectator stand: 200 m².
descriptions.41898: Meilahti Lower Secondary School has a 371 m² sports hall and a 216 m² assembly hall. The halls are booked separately and have evening supervision. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users. The baskets and goals allow basketball, floorball, handball and futsal, but court markings are provided only for basketball.
descriptions.41927: Pakila Elementary School has a 220 m² sports hall available for self-supervised use. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users. The baskets and court markings allow basketball.
descriptions.42042: In addition to bowling lanes, the hall offers a wide range of other activities. The current selection includes archery, a golf simulator, billiards, a maze laser obstacle course, a precision shooting simulator, bowls, giant-glove boxing and a moving platform.
descriptions.42066: A sports hall next to the ice rink, available for separate booking.
descriptions.42092: Gymnastics space for basketball, volleyball and cheerleading. Bulevardin Teatteriyhdistys ry is responsible for activities in the training rooms on the east side.
descriptions.42125: The Sturenkatu campus of Stadin Vocational College has a 342 m² sports hall with evening supervision. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users, but the school lends floorball goals. The baskets and goals allow basketball and floorball. There are no floorball boards.
descriptions.42161: Sauna, gym and café. Meeting rooms with views of the field.
descriptions.42183: The same building houses Töölö Co-educational School's lower secondary classes, upper secondary school and adult upper secondary school.
descriptions.42242: Pikku-Huopalahti Elementary School has a 398 m² sports hall available for self-supervised use. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users, but the school lends a badminton net. The baskets, net and court markings allow basketball and badminton. A mirrored wall makes activities such as dance possible.
descriptions.42256: A small sports hall for the youth centre's activities. The floor is covered with vinyl flooring.
descriptions.42264: Vallila Elementary School has a 199 m² sports hall with evening supervision. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users, but the school lends the large floorball goals kept in the hall. The baskets and goals allow basketball and floorball. There are no floorball boards.
descriptions.42278: Pasila Comprehensive School at Maistraatintori has a 108 m² sports hall with evening supervision. The school's equipment storage is available to evening users if borrowing is agreed in advance. Nets, baskets and small floorball goals allow badminton, basketball and floorball. There are no floorball boards. Note that the hall is small and is not suitable for adult games.
descriptions.42292: A group exercise studio at a company providing wellbeing services.
descriptions.45210:
An outdoor climbing wall in Arabianranta Sports Park, about 5 km from Helsinki city centre.

The climbing wall is freely available during the sports park's opening hours, which you can check via the 'Arabianranta Sports Park' link.

Getting there: Arabianranta Sports Park has no parking area, but there is street parking nearby. You can also get there by public transport or city bike.
descriptions.45552: A small school-use sports hall. It has two basketball hoops, badminton nets, wall bars, a sound system and a stage. There is also a retractable spectator stand, but opening it takes up the entire sports space. Step-free access to the hall and changing rooms.
descriptions.45901: Oulunkylä Elementary School in Veräjälaakso has a 146 m² sports hall available for self-supervised use. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users. The hall has one basketball hoop for practising basketball.
descriptions.45947: Tölö Gymnasium has a 191 m² sports hall with evening supervision. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users, but it may lend large and small floorball goals by prior arrangement. The baskets and court markings allow basketball. A mirrored wall makes activities such as dance possible.
descriptions.46070: A sports hall reserved for school use. It has two basketball hoops, a volleyball net, three badminton nets and floorball goals. The hall also has retractable spectator seating. Step-free access to the hall.
descriptions.48984: Kannelmäki Comprehensive School at Kaarelanraitti has a 150 m² sports hall with evening supervision. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users. Basketball and martial arts are prohibited. The hall can be used for activities such as dance, fitness and group exercise.
descriptions.49957: Aleksis Kivi Comprehensive School has a 218 m² sports hall and a 187 m² assembly hall. The halls are booked separately and available for self-supervised use. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users, but equipment in the small storage cupboards can be borrowed. The nets, baskets, basketballs and large and small floorball goals in the larger hall and storage cupboards allow badminton, volleyball, basketball and floorball. There are no floorball boards.
descriptions.50130: A sports hall specialising in acrobatic activities. Equipment includes two cheerleading and gymnastics mats, a sprung floor (14 × 14 m), an air track (15 × 6 m), a large trampoline (5 × 3 m), a trampoline track (6 × 2 m), a foam pit, and two studios with mirrors.
descriptions.53490: A spacious studio for music-based exercise.
descriptions.57199: Kalasatama Comprehensive School has a 474 m² sports hall available for self-supervised use. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users, but large and small floorball goals and mats can be borrowed. There are no floorball boards. The baskets, other equipment and mirrored wall allow basketball, floorball and dance.
descriptions.59803: Mäkipellontie School is serving as a temporary school for Pohjois-Haaga Elementary School, provisionally until the end of 2020.
descriptions.59824: Alppila Upper Secondary School has a 540 m² sports hall available for self-supervised use. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users. The baskets and goals allow basketball, handball and futsal, but court markings are provided only for futsal.
descriptions.62913: A sandy agility training field maintained by Agility Ry, with a range of agility obstacles. Access is by permission from the association only. The sports park has changing rooms, showers, toilets (including an accessible toilet) and 50 parking spaces.
descriptions.62942:
An outdoor rink in Arabianranta, about 5 km from Helsinki city centre, suitable for activities such as floorball.

The asphalt rink is freely available and has floorball goals. Play is on a first-come, first-served basis; queue for your turn. The rink is open during the sports park's opening hours, which you can check via the 'Arabianranta Sports Park' link.

Getting there: Arabianranta Sports Park has no parking area, but there is street parking nearby. You can also get there by public transport or city bike.
descriptions.68846:
A practice area for disc golf in Arabianranta Sports Park, about 5 km from Helsinki city centre.

The area has one disc golf basket for practising different throws. It is freely available on a first-come, first-served basis; queue for your turn. The practice area is open during the sports park's opening hours, which you can check via the 'Arabianranta Sports Park' link.

Getting there: Arabianranta Sports Park has no parking area, but there is street parking nearby. You can also get there by public transport or city bike.
descriptions.72572:
The sports hall in Postipuisto's residents' facilities is primarily for local residents. People from outside Postipuisto can also book the facilities for private use for a fee.

The sports hall has a basketball hoop, floorball goals, a volleyball net, wall bars, ropes and thin mats. There are also changing rooms and showers. You need to bring your own lock for the lockers.

There is also a small, free fitness room (42 m², 5 × 8 m) for residents, with an exercise bike, rowing machine, bench, dumbbells, kettlebells and mirrors.
descriptions.72583: A full-size sports hall with a comprehensive range of sports equipment. The entire rehabilitation centre is accessible. The hall has wall bars, a game clock, court markings and a separate spectator area. Coaching is available in activities including wheelchair basketball, volleyball, goalball, badminton, boccia and archery.
descriptions.72914: Changing rooms, showers and toilets. There are also meeting rooms for about 50 people.
descriptions.73117: Haaga Comprehensive School on Vanha Viertotie has a 508 m² sports hall available for self-supervised use. The equipment storage containing large floorball goals is available to evening users; the other equipment storage rooms are not. There are no floorball boards. The baskets, goals and court markings allow basketball and floorball. A mirrored wall in a separate room makes activities such as dance possible.
descriptions.73119: Metsola Elementary School has a 289 m² sports hall available for self-supervised use. The school's equipment storage is available to evening users. Nets, baskets, goals and court markings allow badminton, volleyball, basketball, floorball, futsal and handball. There are no floorball boards. Only large floorball goals are available.
descriptions.74724: Kannelmäki Comprehensive School at Kuninkaantammenkierto has a 294 m² sports hall available for self-supervised use. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users. The baskets and court markings allow basketball.
descriptions.75207:
A gym in the ice rink at Pirkkola Sports Park, about a 30-minute journey from Helsinki city centre near the junction of Hämeenlinnanväylä and Ring Road I.

The gym is available only during time slots booked by sports clubs.

Getting there: The sports park has two parking areas. One is next to the ice rink at Plotinrinne 1 and the other is near the swimming pool at Metsätie 6. Accessible parking is available in the car park by the swimming pool. You can also get there by public transport or city bike.
descriptions.75433:
A grass mini-pitch in Siltamäki Sports Park, suitable for playing and practising football. The sports park is in Siltamäki, along the Tuusula Highway.

The park has three small grass fields. They are not freely available and can only be used during booked time slots. The fields can be used during the sports park's opening hours, which you can check via the 'Siltamäki Sports Park' link.

Getting there: The sports park has a parking area and can also be reached by public transport, for example.
descriptions.75525: A school-use sports hall with a stage. Glass doors at one end of the hall restrict ball games.
descriptions.75633: Månsas lågstadieskola has a 228 m² sports hall available for self-supervised use. The school's equipment storage is not available to evening users. The hall has basketball hoops, but none at the end walls.
descriptions.75908: Maunula Elementary School has a 189 m² assembly hall and a 225 m² sports hall. The halls are booked separately and available for self-supervised use. The school's equipment storage is available to evening users. In the assembly hall, nets, baskets and large floorball goals allow badminton, basketball and floorball. There are no floorball boards.
descriptions.75979: The mirrored studio is managed by the city's sports services and is available for evening and leisure-time use. It is self-supervised.
descriptions.78584:
The sports hall at Oulunkylä Sports Park hosts group exercise and other instructor-led activities.

The hall is available only during booked time slots. You can book a slot via the 'Book a facility' link.

For more information about booked time slots at the hall, use the 'See reserved slots' link.

Getting there: Oulunkylä is easy to reach by public transport and bicycle.
descriptions.78588:
The maintenance building at Oulunkylä Sports Park houses fitness and sports halls.

For more information about Oulunkylä Sports Park, use the 'Oulunkylä Sports Park' link.

Getting there: Oulunkylä is easy to reach by public transport and bicycle.
descriptions.78803:
The school was under renovation from June 2024 to June 2025. Bookings for the sports hall began in autumn 2025.
The hall is available for evening and leisure-time use with self-supervised access.
descriptions.78925: Pasila Comprehensive School has a 660 m² sports hall. Users can use larger sports equipment such as floorball goals and mats. There are no floorball boards or futsal goals. The basketball hoops allow basketball.
descriptions.80584:
Pakila Gymnastics Club's sports centre has two dance studios and a group exercise studio. All the sports spaces have sprung sports flooring; the dance studios also have mirrors and dance mats. The spaces have a range of equipment, including kettlebells, exercise mats and wall bars. There is a changing room and shower in the basement.

PNV offers a wide range of recreational sports for children, young people and adults, as well as goal-oriented and competition-focused training in group gymnastics and show dance.
descriptions.80729: Outside the ice-skating season, the artificial ice rink at Oulunkylä Sports Park has a roller hockey rink, two basketball courts, three table football tables, three table tennis tables, two basketball half-courts with one hoop each, and six tennis courts that are freely available.
